data.subject: Local Ledger for Minerva
data.body:
Hi,

Minerva Advisors' most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in CPBI and NODK.

On September 23, 2026, CPBI disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1979332/000094337426000419/cpbi-20260922.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
